title: Artificial Neural Network for Atrial Fibrillation Identification in Portable Devices.
summary: The primary study reports AF-identification AUC on the evaluated portable-device signal dataset. The reported evaluation does not establish prospective performance or clinical benefit in routine monitoring.
ai_technology: An artificial neural network classified atrial fibrillation from signals collected by portable devices.
organization: Department of Information Engineering, Università Politecnica delle Marche, Ancona, Italy

evidence.tested: The primary study reports AF-identification AUC on the evaluated portable-device signal dataset.
evidence.unknown: The reported evaluation does not establish prospective performance or clinical benefit in routine monitoring.
